protocol.benchmark: Bespoke Labs' public decision benchmark: 13 subsets of 11 human-labeled public datasets, 3,880 questions
protocol.client: one request (one question) at a time over HTTP to /v1/systemone, timed by the client
protocol.accuracy: macro: the mean of the 13 subsets; a rejected request counts as wrong
protocol.ece: ten-bin expected calibration error of the top probability; pooled over all 3,880 questions
